# Punt TO: Player Targets

**Summary.** In our 9-cat head-to-head league, turnovers are the one category you can give up without hurting your build. Every first-round player turns the ball over, and streaming for games raises turnovers anyway. Build around high-usage players who bring assists, points and threes, pay expert prices rather than site prices, and use turnovers only to break a tie between two otherwise equal players.

## Why experts ignore turnovers in H2H

Turnovers are the only negative counting stat in our nine categories. One expert ignores them in every head-to-head league, and a second ignores them completely in head-to-head. A third says anyone drafting high-usage, high-value players should punt turnovers, because those players cannot avoid them. ([07-15](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=2119), [09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=549), [07-15](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=1857), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=303))

Turnovers are a third of the usage formula, so every first-round player has high turnovers. If you spend big on a top player in our 200 USD auction, you are already losing turnovers in most weeks. Decide before the draft that turnovers will not limit your bids. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=2141), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=303))

Category correlations point the same way. High assists come with high turnovers. Low turnovers come with low points and low assists. Chasing low turnovers means giving up points and assists, which are two of our nine categories. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=588))

## Streaming raises turnovers anyway

In head-to-head you want to max out games played. With daily lineups and up to 6 acquisitions a week, a manager who streams for games will add turnovers with every extra game. Chasing low turnovers works against how this format is won. ([07-15](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=2119), [09-14](https://youtu.be/t4n9MAP2_14?t=813))

The reverse also holds. Injuries and light schedules lower your turnovers automatically, so you often win turnovers in weeks when you are short on games. Do not bench a healthy player to protect turnovers. Start every player who has a game and use your weekly adds for extra games. ([07-15](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=2208), [07-15](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=2119))

Punting turnovers does not fix short playoff weeks for counting stats. Our weeks 19 to 21 matter most. Cleveland has only two games in our finals week, which lowers Donovan Mitchell and James Harden. Anthony Edwards has a two-game semifinal week. LaMelo Ball has a two-game week in the week of March 15. Houston plays only 10 games across our playoffs, which hurts Kevin Durant and Alperen Sengun. Dallas (4-4-4), Memphis (4-4-4) and the Clippers (4-3-4) give Cooper Flagg, Cameron Boozer and Brandon Ingram a late boost. ([Donovan Mitchell](../profiles/players/donovan-mitchell.md), [James Harden](../profiles/players/james-harden.md), [Anthony Edwards](../profiles/players/anthony-edwards.md), [LaMelo Ball](../profiles/players/lamelo-ball.md), [Kevin Durant](../profiles/players/kevin-durant.md), [Alperen Sengun](../profiles/players/alperen-sengun.md), [Cooper Flagg](../profiles/players/cooper-flagg.md), [Cameron Boozer](../profiles/players/cameron-boozer.md), [Brandon Ingram](../profiles/players/brandon-ingram.md))

## Where the notes differ

The experts agree that turnovers matter little in head-to-head. They differ on whether they should count at all. One side punts them outright and ignores them completely. The other side gives them a small weight: one expert says using turnovers to break a tie between two otherwise identical players is fine, and another says low turnovers simply matter less in head-to-head. Our rule: ignore turnovers when you set a bid limit, and use them only to choose between two players at the same price and fit. ([09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=303), [07-15](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=1857), [07-15](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=2232), [09-14](https://youtu.be/t4n9MAP2_14?t=813))

There is a second tension, about centers. One expert's head-to-head system pushes centers down and says box-score values overrate blocks, steals and some percentages. The player notes still treat Nikola Jokić and Victor Wembanyama as the top two picks and best punt TO fits, because turnovers are their only weak category. If you buy a big man for blocks, check that he also brings points, rebounds or assists. Wembanyama alone still needs a second shot blocker to lock up blocks. ([09-14](https://youtu.be/t4n9MAP2_14?t=813), [Nikola Jokić](../profiles/players/nikola-jokic.md), [Victor Wembanyama](../profiles/players/victor-wembanyama.md))

## Who gains value for a punt TO team

The biggest winners are players whose only weak category is turnovers. In the notes that means Jokić, Wembanyama, Luka Dončić, Edwards, Durant, Flagg and LeBron James. On a punt TO team their whole line counts and nothing is lost. ([Nikola Jokić](../profiles/players/nikola-jokic.md), [Victor Wembanyama](../profiles/players/victor-wembanyama.md), [Luka Dončić](../profiles/players/luka-doncic.md), [Anthony Edwards](../profiles/players/anthony-edwards.md), [Kevin Durant](../profiles/players/kevin-durant.md), [Cooper Flagg](../profiles/players/cooper-flagg.md), [LeBron James](../profiles/players/lebron-james.md))

The next group is assist-heavy ball handlers with big turnover numbers: Cade Cunningham, Trae Young, Josh Giddey, Harden, Dejounte Murray and Ja Morant. Their turnovers hurt any team that competes in the category. On a punt TO team they become cheap sources of assists. ([Cade Cunningham](../profiles/players/cade-cunningham.md), [Trae Young](../profiles/players/trae-young.md), [Josh Giddey](../profiles/players/josh-giddey.md), [James Harden](../profiles/players/james-harden.md), [Dejounte Murray](../profiles/players/dejounte-murray.md), [Ja Morant](../profiles/players/ja-morant.md), [09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=588))

Some fits are double punts. Giannis Antetokounmpo works best when you also punt FT%. Ball, Young, Harden, Brandon Miller and Jalen Green also fit punt FG%. Sengun and Paolo Banchero also fit punt FT%. If you pair punt TO with a second punt, pick these players on purpose, not by accident. ([Giannis Antetokounmpo](../profiles/players/giannis-antetokounmpo.md), [LaMelo Ball](../profiles/players/lamelo-ball.md), [Trae Young](../profiles/players/trae-young.md), [James Harden](../profiles/players/james-harden.md), [Brandon Miller](../profiles/players/brandon-miller.md), [Jalen Green](../profiles/players/jalen-green.md), [Alperen Sengun](../profiles/players/alperen-sengun.md), [Paolo Banchero](../profiles/players/paolo-banchero.md))

## How to price the tiers

Elite anchors: plan to spend about 80 to 90 USD for Jokić, about 80 USD for Wembanyama, above value for Dončić, and about 60 to 62 USD for Giannis. One of these takes 30 to 45 percent of a 200 USD budget, so the rest of the roster has to come from the value tiers below. ([Nikola Jokić](../profiles/players/nikola-jokic.md), [Victor Wembanyama](../profiles/players/victor-wembanyama.md), [Luka Dončić](../profiles/players/luka-doncic.md), [Giannis Antetokounmpo](../profiles/players/giannis-antetokounmpo.md))

First and second round: pay expert prices, not site prices. Experts put Edwards at about 40 to 45 USD and Cunningham at 45 to 50 USD, so let others pay the Yahoo or ESPN number. About 50 USD is fair for Jayson Tatum, low 40s for Durant, 40 to 45 USD for Flagg, and 35 to 40 USD as a ceiling for Jalen Johnson. ([Anthony Edwards](../profiles/players/anthony-edwards.md), [Cade Cunningham](../profiles/players/cade-cunningham.md), [Jayson Tatum](../profiles/players/jayson-tatum.md), [Kevin Durant](../profiles/players/kevin-durant.md), [Cooper Flagg](../profiles/players/cooper-flagg.md), [Jalen Johnson](../profiles/players/jalen-johnson.md))

The middle rounds are where punt TO pays most. Several veterans who cost 40 USD or more in our league last season now carry expert prices in the low to mid 20s: Devin Booker, Harden and Domantas Sabonis. Stephen Curry falls in the same range but carries knee risk. Players the markets underrate, like Darius Garland, Keyonte George, Jaren Jackson Jr. and Murray, are worth bidding to the expert range, even above their Yahoo average cost. ([Devin Booker](../profiles/players/devin-booker.md), [James Harden](../profiles/players/james-harden.md), [Domantas Sabonis](../profiles/players/domantas-sabonis.md), [Stephen Curry](../profiles/players/stephen-curry.md), [Darius Garland](../profiles/players/darius-garland.md), [Keyonte George](../profiles/players/keyonte-george.md), [Jaren Jackson Jr.](../profiles/players/jaren-jackson.md), [Dejounte Murray](../profiles/players/dejounte-murray.md))

Late in the draft, take cheap punt TO bodies for the bench and IL. Ingram is a 1 to 3 USD IL stash, since we have 4 IL slots. AJ Dybantsa, Derik Queen, Morant, Green and Stephon Castle are a few USD each. In the first weeks, check minutes and assists for each target. Do not check their turnovers. ([Brandon Ingram](../profiles/players/brandon-ingram.md), [AJ Dybantsa](../profiles/players/aj-dybantsa.md), [Derik Queen](../profiles/players/derik-queen.md), [Ja Morant](../profiles/players/ja-morant.md), [Jalen Green](../profiles/players/jalen-green.md), [Stephon Castle](../profiles/players/stephon-castle.md))
